predictor.notes: This predictor matches all 24 observed prices, using 10 REA operations including inspection. Observations support a minimum charge of 98,594 cents through quantity 136, a price of 29,405 + 508*q through quantity 500, and a 23% reduction of that linear price starting at 501, rounded to whole cents. Both sides of each inferred boundary were queried: 136/137 and 500/501. All requests succeeded and reported roundingCents=0. The model is strongly supported by the sampled quantities but is not proven for every unqueried integer; additional unsampled changes cannot be ruled out.
